query: SELECT item.item_id AS "item_id!" FROM folioharbor.holdings holding JOIN folioharbor.items item USING(holding_id) JOIN folioharbor.item_assets asset USING(item_id) WHERE holding.library_id=$1 AND holding.state='active' AND item.state='active' AND asset.asset_kind='original' AND asset.blob_id=$2 ORDER BY item.created_at LIMIT 1
